direction: Interior of the estate office. The draughtsman (C_FRED) stands at a sloped drawing desk by the window, laying a last wash on a fair-copy plan of field parcels, with woods tinted green. He has quills, an ink pot, brass dividers and a boxwood scale rule beside him. The agent (E_AGENT) comes in with his leather document case. Slow lateral move across the desk. Ambience only: a quill scratching, a clock ticking, cartwheels outside.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 still, interior of an 1820s Welsh estate office, a lean man with sandy hair and a moustache wearing a dark 1820s clerk's coat and white stock, bent over a sloped drawing desk inking a hand-drawn estate plan with green-washed woodland and field boundaries, quill pens, ink pot, brass dividers, boxwood scale rule, morning window light, behind him a pale clean-shaven man in thin-rimmed spectacles and a dark frock coat entering with a leather document case, plain panelled walls, no crests, no heraldry, no legible text
